method: One synthetic (no customer data) strict json_schema request to POST /v1/responses per model, store=false, stream=false.
note: No keys, connection ids or health data are recorded here. Free-tier quotas and catalogues change; re-run check_omniroute and qualify_v2_models before relying on this.
reported_identity_rule: OmniRoute echoes the requested id without its leading provider segment. CoverGuide does not strip by pattern; each allowlisted model declares its exact reported id.

gateway_facts.bind: Set OMNIROUTE_SERVER_HOST=127.0.0.1; HOSTNAME and HOST are ignored and the default is 0.0.0.0.
gateway_facts.logging: New keys default to noLog=false and compression on; both must be changed for CoverGuide.
gateway_facts.routing: round-robin with sticky limit 3 across several keys per provider was confirmed with a 12-call test.
